behaviour.note: Pin/table infrastructure complete (cross-protocol 769 -> 768, world 4189 -> 4082, packet rewire: pick_item restored, pick_item_from_block/entity and player_loaded removed, 25 play serverbound packets renumbered; adapter re-based to 768; 6/6 tables regenerated; component codec re-pinned to the 1.21.3 wire (custom_model_data int form); oracles ported to the 1.21.3 APIs); behaviour port unstarted. Behaviour code is still the 26.3 base's. The delta is 313 items: 9 rank-1 (pin, 6 regenerate items, save-format step 4189 -> 4082 with 0 schemas, 2 fixes added, 4 datafix classes changed, version facts), 189 rank-2 (harness reruns), 90 rank-3 (unproved), 23 rank-4, 2 rank-5. The resin and eyeblossom content (11 blocks, 10 items), the pale oak leaves particle and 15 sound events are removed; the creaking transient entity (30) returns; LevelParticles loses alwaysShow, SetHeldSlot is a byte, PlayerInfoUpdate loses UPDATE_HAT.

harness.note: No local profile: the local sweep was skipped deliberately. The 1.21.6 publish spent ~4h30m on local sweep attempts that produced no profile (the fast-profile horizon-client build OOMs on this VM's 6 GB under 3-stream load), and disk quota pressure (~98G of ~100-103G) rules out the local sweep's multi-GB build trees. The profile is to be measured on CI (port-verify dispatched after merge).

notes: SlotDisplay codec still uses 26.3 numbering (carried from 1.21.8 via 1.21.7/1.21.6/1.21.5/1.21.4); the eight SlotDisplay entries are identical in 1.21.3, 1.21.4 and 1.21.5, same order, so the 770 fix values apply unchanged. jsr305 (javax.annotation.Nullable) is committed at tools/jsr305-3.0.2.jar and on the javac classpaths. Oracles ported to the 1.21.3 APIs (AttributeMap.resetBaseValue replicated from the 1.21.4 bytecode, Level dragonParts removed, BlockModel textureMap/parentLocation/hasAmbientOcclusion); horizon-prepare exit 0 in 641.2 s. Pick resolution is client-side at this pin and guests are loaded from join (vanilla 1.21.3 has no load gating); the native pick-item hook has no call site. Tooltip display: the pin has no tooltip_display component (a 1.21.5 addition) — the codec synthesizes it from hide_tooltip/hide_additional_tooltip plus per-component show_in_tooltip flags; writing to 1.21.5+ servers drops the hiding (known gap, see PORT-NOTES).
